column2: the plan adds `--skill` and requires `test-design-structure` to call `--skill design`, but `main()` still uses `scan_all()` today. if the flag only filters argv messaging or post-scan output, implement-only baseline growth can still make `test-design-structure` fail even when `design` `skill.md` is unchanged.

the new `--skill` filter is not constrained against `--write`. if `main()` honors the filter during baseline regeneration, `python3 python/cli.py lint skill-closure-growth --write --skill design` can rewrite `python/skill-closure-baseline.json` with only one row. `load_baseline()` expects exactly one row per gated skill (`design`, `implement`) with a fixed `baseline_keys` set, so the committed two-row ratchet becomes invalid and subsequent default lint runs fail closed until manual repair.

the plan wires the new ratchet through `cli_py`, but `cli_py` currently points at `python/larch/cli.py`, which defines `main()` without executing it when run as a script. the replacement command `python3 "$cli_py" lint skill-closure-growth --skill design` can exit without running the linter, so `test-design-structure` can pass even when design tokens grow.
